create_episodic_dataset: create an EpisodicDataset from a Gym environment and Agent to collect episode trajectories
iterate_episodic_dataset: iterate over an EpisodicDataset to yield trajectory dictionaries for each episode
run_episodes_with_agent: run multiple episodes using run_episode with a Gym env and Agent to collect data
get_dataset_length: get the number of episodes from an EpisodicDataset using the len function
reset_env_for_episodes: reset the Gym environment before iterating episodes in an EpisodicDataset
